info.title: OneNexus Central Auth Service — Customer API
info.description: Customer-facing JSON RPC operations under `/api/*`. OAuth 2.1 / OIDC protocol endpoints under `/connect/*` are documented separately by their respective specs and the OIDC discovery document at `/.well-known/openid-configuration`.

Bearer.description: CAS-issued OAuth 2.0 bearer token with the onenexus-cas-api audience.
